description: This source file defines the Leaderboard page logic for an online examination system, handling user session verification, database access to retrieve user info, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: ASP.NET WebForms code-behind class for managing the leaderboard page, including session validation and user navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; verifies user session, retrieves user semester info from database, and stores it in session.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for leaderboard button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by resetting the session ID and redirecting to the login page.
